title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - IRDI
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/IRDI . International Registration Data Identifier (IRDI), based on the international standards ISO/IEC 11179-6, ISO 29002 and ISO 6532, used in eCl@ss and the Asset Administration Shell as a unique identifier. Subclass of s4inma:ID per the SAREF4INMA ontology; the generic hasIDValue property is inherited from ID and documented there (this class uses the equivalent, more specific hasIRDIValue property instead, which is declared in the ontology as a sub-property of hasIDValue).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'IRDI'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasIRDIValue.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/hasIRDIValue'. The value of the IRDI as a string, e.g. '0173-1#02-AAO677#002' (eCl@ss format).
